title: Bare Bones x Just 3D Trims
description: Simplifies the textures of the 3D armour trims for Bare Bones
body:
This pack retextures the 19 armour trims from [Just 3D Trims](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-3d-trims/versions) to fit in with Bare Bones.
